# dsh-pet-progress
**English** · 中文说明
**A progress bar for your desktop pet.**

The dsh web pet shows what the agent
is doing *right now* — thinking, calling a tool, done. It has n

o way to show how
much of a long task is finished, so a task that is 90% done looks exactly like
one

uch of a long task is finished, so a task that is 90% done looks exactly like
one that just started.

This plugin fixes that. It reads the todo lists and goals your agent already
writes to the session,

and folds them into a percentage bubble on the pet.
A session that never writes a todo list isn't le

ft blank either — there the
bubble falls back to a plain line saying what is happening right now.
## Install
One command, using the plugin's full GitHub URL:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

This requires the dsh web pet to be
installed. If it is missing, the plugin stays loaded but publish

es nothing —
you'll see a note in the dsh log rather than a crash.

**Restart DSH afterwards** — bundles are read only at startup, so the plugin
won't mount until you d

o. The bubble then appears on its own the next time your
agent writes a todo list or starts a goal;
there is nothing to switch on.
For a named profile, use `dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`.
## What you'll see
A small bubble above the pet, updated whenever the todo list or the goal changes:
| Situation | Bubble |

| Todo list, one task in progress | `3/7 · 43%` titled with that task |
| Todo list, several tasks i

n progress | `3/7 · 43%`, naming them — up to three, `+N` for the rest |
| All todos done | `任务全部完成`

in green — a moment, gone after about 10 seconds |
| Long-lived goal with no todos | `2/8 轮` — the

goal's round budget |
| Goal finished | `目标完成` in green — also a moment |
| Goal blocked | The block

reason, in place of progress |
| No todo list and no goal | A plain line with no percentage — what
the model is thinking (`正在思考`), the words it is writing (`最近输出`), or what the tool it just called is
inking (`正在思考`), the words it is writing (`最近输出`), or what the tool it just called is for (`当前过程`) |

A standing bubble fades out about 30 seconds after the last progress update, so a
finished turn does

n't leave a stale percentage on screen; it comes back by itself
if the work resumes. A **moment** —

a finished list or a finished goal — is
announced once and never renewed, so it clears itself instea

d of sitting there;
it also keeps the bubble for those ten seconds, because the agent usually starts
talking again immediately and would otherwise replace it before you read it.

Several sessions can be open at once — the most recently active one owns the
bubble.
## Checking the full list

The bubble is one line, so there's a button for the rest: click **进度** on the
pet panel and the comp
lete todo list is written to the dsh log.
## Good to know

- **It never over-reports.** A todo whose status the plugin doesn't recognise
counts as *not done*.

If every entry in a write is unreadable, the plugin
treats it as "no information" and keeps what it

had.
- **It won't guess.** It names the tasks that are actually in progress — up to
three, each trim

med to 32 characters, with `+N` when more are running. It never
picks one of several and pretends th

at one is the work.
- **It reads, it doesn't judge.** A percentage comes from the todo lists and
goa

ls your agent writes; the plugin never infers progress from how long
something has been running. Wit

hout either, it shows the plain activity line
instead of a number.
- **It says what is happening, no

t just which phase.** With no task list it
follows the model's own words as they stream — the thinki

ng first, then the
answer, newest words only, since those are the ones that say what is going on
now

— and it names what a tool call is *for* (`正在调用 pwsh：npm test`,
`正在调用 read：progress.ts`), not only
that a tool is running.
## Requirements

The plugin binds to the pet's plugin-seam contract (`announce`,
`registerPanelAction`, and the `sess

ion/event` channel); an older pet does not
expose all three.
## Configuration
[代码示例省略，未执行]
With `enabled: false` nothing mounts. `heartbeatMs` defaults to `10000`.
## Using it from code

The plugin is host-only (no client bundle). The pet service is available as
`ctx.pet`, and the same
three seams the pet publishes are what this plugin uses:
| Seam | Used for |
| `ctx.on('session/event', …)` | Reading `todo/write`, `goal/change`, and the turn/step/tool/message

events behind the activity line |
| `ctx.pet.announce(…)` | Publishing the progress bubble |
| `ctx
.pet.registerPanelAction(…)` | The `进度` panel button |

Adjust `PROGRESS_TTL_MS` and `MAX_TRACKED_SESSIONS` in
`src/progress.ts` to change the fade-out and

how many sessions
are tracked at once.
## Development

`src/*.ts` is the source of truth; `lib/` is committed build output, because the
cordis loader does

no transpilation. **After editing `src/`, rebuild and commit
`lib/` with it — CI fails if the two dr

tion. **After editing `src/`, rebuild and commit
`lib/` with it — CI fails if the two drift apart.**
[代码示例省略，未执行]
To work on the code, skip installing and point the profile at your checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

A `bundles` entry alone is not enough — the package must also be a dependency.
If the path contains

non-ASCII characters, write it as a `file://` URL. Restart
the app afterwards.

Node is pinned in `package.json` `engines` and exercised in CI at `22.19.0` and
`24.x`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## More

- Design notes — why the plugin is built this way: the event
gap it fills, why it's a sibling rather

than a patch, what it reports, and the
two non-obvious details (deferred mounting, and an announcem

ent slot with no
retract).
